instruction: A faceted scorpion with a broad angular carapace made of large flat triangles in burnt orange and sand tan, each plane catching a distinctly different shade. Its segmented tail arcs high overhead in eight tapering blocks ending in a single sharp cone stinger, and two chunky pincers open forward from angular arms. Eight straight-edged legs plant it in a wide stance with no smoothing anywhere on the surface.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Low Poly Scorpion in a low-poly flat-shaded style. A faceted scorpion with a broad angular carapace made of large flat triangles in burnt orange and sand tan, each plane catching a distinctly different shade. Its segmented tail arcs high overhead in eight tapering blocks ending in a single sharp cone stinger, and two chunky pincers open forward from angular arms. Eight straight-edged legs plant it in a wide stance with no smoothing anywhere on the surface. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
